C-CHAINS.statement: Ordinary cellular homology with a finite-rank local system uses direct sums of fibers, hence finite-support chains, also on an infinite cover.

C-SUBCOMPLEX.statement: For a subcomplex A of a complex T of dimension at most two, H_2(A;L|A) injects into H_2(T;L), without a fundamental-group injectivity hypothesis.

C-COINVARIANTS.statement: On a connected complex H_0 with local coefficients is the fiber's coinvariant space; in rank one a nontrivial character makes it zero.

C-DECK.statement: The canonical deck action on a pulled-back local system is identity on the downstairs fiber and commutes with parallel transport; cellular chains of an infinite cyclic cover of a finite complex are finite free k[z,z^-1]-modules.

C-SPECIALIZATION.statement: Coinvariants for the canonical deck action identify the upstairs chain complex at z=1 with the downstairs local-coefficient chain complex; no character value is lost.

C-LAURENT-RANK.statement: A matrix over k[z,z^-1] with injective specialization at z=1 is injective over k[z,z^-1], including the zero-column case.

C-CYCLIC.statement: For every finite connected complex A of dimension at most two, rank-one complex local system L, and connected infinite cyclic cover p, H_2(A;L)=0 implies H_2(Ahat;p*L)=0.

C-SIMPLICIAL.statement: A finite CW complex of dimension at most two has a finite simplicial homotopy model of dimension at most two, so the given map can be made simplicial after one fixed subdivision of its finite domain.

C-LIFT.statement: If b_1(F;Q)=0 and F is finite and connected, every composite pi_1(F)->pi_1(A)->Z is zero; a simplicial map F->A lifts simplicially to that cyclic cover without subdividing F again.

C-COUNT.statement: An image lift through a connected nontrivial cover has strictly more simplices than its downstairs image, unless the cover has a section; the simplex count never exceeds the fixed domain's count.

C-MAXIMAL-TOWER.statement: Every simplicial map from finite connected F with b_1(F;Q)=0 has a cyclic-tower image A of maximal simplex count, and that A has b_1(A;Q)=0.
C-MAXIMAL-TOWER.source: Independent maximal-tower formulation of the manuscript's termination step

C-EULER.statement: A finite connected two-dimensional complex with nontrivial rank-one monodromy and zero twisted H_2 has chi<=0, hence b_1(-;Q)>=1.

C-TOWER.statement: For finite connected Y of dimension at most two and rank-one complex L with H_2(Y;L)=0, every map F->Y from finite connected simplicial F with b_1(F;Q)=0 pulls L back to trivial monodromy.

C-TORSION.statement: Under the tower theorem's hypotheses every finite-order element of pi_1(Y) lies in the kernel of the character.

C-PLUS-COVER.statement: After killing a finitely normally generated perfect K by two-cells, the preimage Bbar in the universal cover is connected, has fundamental group K, and has H_1(Bbar;Z)=0.

C-PLUS-SURJECTION.statement: For R=ZG the relative complex of the new two-cells is R^r[2], and H_2(Bprime-tilde;Z) surjects R-linearly onto R^r.

C-PLUS-ATTACH.statement: Degree-two Hurewicz representatives of lifts of the r relative basis vectors give r three-cell attachments with q*d_3=id_R^r.

C-ARBITRARY-MODULES.statement: The split injection d_3 and the degreewise split contractible relative complex imply universal-cover H_i=0 for i>2, H^3(X;M)=0 for every left R-module, and homology preservation for every right R-module without flatness or finite generation.

C-PLUS.statement: A finite connected two-dimensional B and a perfect normal subgroup K normally generated by r elements admit the manuscript's finite plus construction using r two-cells and r three-cells, with all three stated properties.

C-COMMUTATORS.statement: In the stated presentation, t_1=a_2^26=[t_2,a_2] and s*t_2*s^-1=a_1^15=[t_1,a_1], with commutator [u,v]=uvu^-1v^-1.

C-NONCOMMUTATIVE-MODULE.statement: In K_ab, with its genuine left ZG conjugation action, u_1=(1-a_2)u_2 and s*u_2=(1-a_1)u_1; norm sums give 26u_1=0 and 15u_2=0 without commuting distinct actions.

C-PERFECT.statement: The normal closure of x_1^2 and x_2^3 in the manuscript's five-generator four-relator group P is perfect.

C-CHARACTER.statement: The assignments (x_1,a_1,x_2,a_2,s)=(-1,zeta,zeta^2,-1,1), zeta^2+zeta+1=0, respect every relator and kill both normal generators, defining a character of G=P/K.

C-FOX.statement: Word-level evaluated Fox differentiation gives exactly the manuscript's four-by-five row boundary matrix over Q[zeta]/(zeta^2+zeta+1), and D*d_1=0 in the stated right-coefficient/left-chain convention.

C-MINOR.statement: The x_1,a_1,x_2,s column minor of the independently reconstructed Fox matrix is -4(1-zeta^2), is nonzero, and hence the twisted second boundary is injective.

C-TWISTED.statement: The local system L_rho on the finite plus complex X has H_2(X;L_rho)=0.

C-QUOTIENT.statement: G has an epimorphism to Z sending s to 1 and the other generators to 0; x_1 has order exactly two in G, detected by rho(x_1)=-1.

C-MAIN.statement: There exists a finite connected three-dimensional CW complex X with infinite fundamental group, H_i(Xtilde;Z)=0 for i>2 and H^3(X;M)=0 for every left Zpi_1(X)-module M, but no finite two-dimensional homotopy model.

C-KNOWN-TOWERS.statement: The maximal cyclic-tower method is prior work, but its existence theorem alone does not establish preservation of the present twisted H_2 under a cyclic cover.

Both are finite D(2) complexes; a finite two-dimensional homotopy model implies the finite-cover condition.
C-FR-COVER-NONPRESERVATION.engineer_assessment: Independently accepted exact consequence of the construction and reduction. It is not a stronger obstruction than the scalar method with finite covers. It remains the scalar-blind part of the precise joint contribution under review; its old significance-only route stays retired.

C-FR-KNOWN-INDUCTION.source: HKL10, Theorem 3.1 and equation (3.1), p. 928; Section 2, p. 927
C-FR-KNOWN-INDUCTION.engineer_assessment: The Host independently confirmed the published primary passage and its applicability. All fifteen pre-existing canonical attributions, including this one, remain unchanged.

C-FR-ORIGINALITY.statement: The exact strictness of the all-field base-space scalar tower condition versus its finite-cover closure within finite D(2) complexes is an original publishable contribution despite the induced-character reduction and absence of extra nonrealizability reach beyond the cover-aware scalar method.
C-FR-ORIGINALITY.engineer_assessment: Inconclusive. Corollary 3.3 gives a precise base-space incompleteness witness, but no new realization reach, classification gain beyond that strictness, or demonstrated computational advantage is supplied. Numerical minimality of rank and cover degree is not a significance argument. Host review must assess whether this residual contribution itself is original and publishable.

C-FR-CONTRIBUTION.statement: Deliver the representation-relative structural theorem and a genuinely additional two-dimensional realization consequence with independently assessed correctness, originality, grounding, and publishable significance.
C-FR-CONTRIBUTION.engineer_assessment: The accepted proofs, exact witnesses, double-cover reduction, strictness corollary, and fifteen independent source attributions are preserved. This earlier significance route is retired in favor of the live exact-relation-gap contribution, without revising its historical judgments.

C-RG-NORMAL-CLOSURES.statement: For n=5,6, [w,a2]=t1 in P_n, the P_n-normal closures of w and {t1,t2} agree, and R_n is the F_n-normal closure of r1,...,r_(n-1),w. These are explicit balanced presentations of the previously studied quotients.
C-RG-NORMAL-CLOSURES.engineer_assessment: Prose proof plus new literal free-group relator products. In the quotient by w, commutation follows from t2=t1^-1=a2^-26, not from commuting unrelated actions.

C-RG-LOCAL-H1.statement: H0 and H1 with a fixed right ZG-module depend only on the identified fundamental group. The accepted acyclic systems therefore have zero H0,H1 on every presentation complex of G5 or G6.
C-RG-LOCAL-H1.engineer_assessment: Explicit partial-free-resolution comparison maps and homotopies prove the transfer after tensoring. No H2 invariance, asphericity, homotopy equivalence of presentation complexes, or flatness is assumed.

C-RG-DEFICIENCY.statement: Every finite p-generator q-relator presentation of G_n, n=5,6, satisfies p-q<=0. The explicit balanced presentations attain Def(G_n)=0 with the generators-minus-relators convention.
C-RG-DEFICIENCY.engineer_assessment: Euler gives dim H2=dim(V_n)*(1-p+q), hence deficiency at most one. Equality forces H2=0 while x1 has order two and acts by -I, contradicting the accepted torsion obstruction. For G6 the same contradiction follows from a scalar system on the double cover.

C-RG-MODULE.statement: For n=5,6, the minimal left ZG_n-generator number of R_n/[R_n,R_n] is exactly n-1.
C-RG-MODULE.engineer_assessment: Perfectness gives R_n=N_n[R_n,R_n] and the upper bound. The tensor of the Fox relation map has image containing the accepted full-rank old-relator image. Comparing its dimension with dim(V_n)*k for k module generators proves the lower bound without tensoring an injection or identifying module-generator number with rank.

C-RG-EXACT.statement: For n=5,6 and the specified epimorphism F_n->G_n, d_F_n(R_n)=n, d_ZG_n(R_n/[R_n,R_n])=n-1, and Def(G_n)=0. Both explicit balanced presentations have exact relation gap one.
C-RG-EXACT.engineer_assessment: A finite normal generating set of size m yields an n-generator m-relator presentation, so the universal deficiency bound gives m>=n. This is not a restricted Tietze exclusion. The Host independently supports the theorem in relation_gap_review; its statement, proof, and ledger version are retained.

C-RG-WITNESSES.statement: The standalone verifier reconstructs exact free-group witnesses for the new presentation equivalences, verifies the added relator's evaluated Fox derivative, and rejects deliberately corrupted witnesses.
C-RG-WITNESSES.engineer_assessment: Six distinct word witnesses, including four new ones, pass in each of two presentations. Sixteen corruptions are rejected, and an independent public-CLI mutation exits one with the intended free-reduction error. The successful univariate Jacobian operation checks only a new cyclotomic product identity. The rejected multivariate request is retained as a non-conclusion.

C-RG-PREDECESSORS.statement: Mannan Section 4 supplies the partial-presentation/perfect-kernel/deficiency bridge; Bridson-Tweedale Sections 2-4 provide conditional candidates and restricted exclusions, while Proposition 5.1 rules out Lustig criterion proofs of a relation gap. These do not replace the universal deficiency bound proved here.
C-RG-PREDECESSORS.source: Mannan 2009 Section 4; Bridson-Tweedale arXiv math/0607671v2 Sections 2-5
C-RG-PREDECESSORS.engineer_assessment: The Host independently supports this older-source comparison and all three canonical attributions; all eighteen existing attributions remain confirmed. This accepted claim is unchanged. The stronger BBMN comparison is recorded separately in C-RG-BBMN-COMPARISON rather than invalidating these source judgments.

Its Corollary B explicitly depends on OpenAI Corollary 2.3 and uses the same low-degree local-homology transfer, Euler calculation, and detected-torsion mechanism as this campaign to obtain deficiency zero. The source treats its two-generator family, not the specified G5/G6 counts or this all-field scalar-blind application. General finite-gap existence and a new deficiency mechanism are therefore unavailable originality claims. This is a primary-source comparison, not independent certification of every proof in BBMN.
C-RG-BBMN-COMPARISON.source: BBMN arXiv:2610.23637v1, Theorem A; qualification preceding Corollary B; Corollary B and its proof
C-RG-BBMN-COMPARISON.engineer_assessment: Supported as a bibliographic and mechanism comparison using the retained independent Reviewer excerpt. The two new canonical citation entries await Host attribution. BBMN is not an added premise of C-RG-EXACT or any previously accepted mathematical proof.

The specific mathematical package is accepted, but no substantive publication-level added value beyond BBMN and the cover-aware scalar method is established. Absence of the exact G5/G6 formulas from BBMN, additional examples, and exact replay do not establish novelty or significance.
